gbm_population_evidence.quote: Healthy infant aged 5-36 months at the time of first study vaccination
Each immunising dose contains 80 antigen units of inactivated hepatitis A virus (GBM strain).

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a Phase IIb randomised controlled trial of the safety, immunogenicity and efficacy of the malaria vaccine candidates R78C with Matrix-M™, and the combination of RH5.1 and R21 with Matrix-M™, in children aged 5-36 months in Burkina Faso.

role_evidence.quote: R78C: A soluble RIPR EGF-CyRPA fusion protein vaccine

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational blood-stage malaria vaccine (RIPR EGF-CyRPA fusion protein); not an antitumour agent

role_evidence.quote: RH5.1: A soluble protein vaccine against the RH5 antigen

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational blood-stage malaria vaccine (RH5 protein); not an antitumour agent

role_evidence.quote: R21: A protein particle comprising recombinant HBsAg fused to the central repeat and the C-terminus of the circumsporozoite protein

agents.drug_class_hint: pre-erythrocytic malaria vaccine (circumsporozoite protein particle); not an antitumour agent

role_evidence.quote: Rabivax-S is an inactivated, freeze-dried, single-dose vaccine.

agents.drug_class_hint: licensed inactivated rabies vaccine used as control vaccine

role_evidence.quote: Menveo is a tetravalent meningitis vaccine that consists of one vial of MenA powder and one vial of Men CWY solution.

agents.drug_class_hint: licensed meningococcal ACWY conjugate vaccine used as control vaccine

role_evidence.quote: Avaxim 80 is an inactivated, adsorbed hepatitis A vaccine.

agents.drug_class_hint: licensed inactivated hepatitis A vaccine used as control vaccine

coder_notes: Off-topic record: paediatric malaria vaccine trial in healthy infants (stdAges CHILD only; would also fail S4). The only 'GBM' string is the hepatitis A virus 'GBM strain' in the Avaxim 80 description, not glioblastoma. All interventions are infectious-disease vaccines/adjuvant, listed as excluded_intervention_type for transparency; they are not antitumour agents. Rabivax-S and the Group 3 vaccines serve as control vaccines (Group 3 is the registered placebo comparator).
